name: coagent8-mcp
displayName: CoAgent8 - MCP bridge to coding CLIs
description: Ask Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity for second opinions and Git reviews from VS Code chat through MCP.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CoAgent8 runs local coding CLIs and requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CoAgent8 needs a filesystem workspace and locally available Node.js and coding CLIs.

commands.title: CoAgent8: Register or Repair Native Chat Hosts
CoAgent8: Preview and Remove Owned Registrations

markdownEnumDescriptions: Choose among the allowed backends by routing strategy.
coagent8.defaultBackend.markdownDescription: Backend used when a request does not name one. Overrides `defaultBackend` in config.json only when set here.

coagent8.routing.allowedBackends.markdownDescription: Backends CoAgent8 may run (`gemini` is Antigravity). Overrides `routing.allowedBackends` in config.json only when set here.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Prefer a backend whose quota is not exhausted.
coagent8.routing.strategy.markdownDescription: How an automatic request chooses a backend. Overrides `routing.strategy` in config.json only when set here.

coagent8.codex.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Codex when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.codex.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.claude.defaultModel.patternErrorMessage: Enter a model identifier or alias such as opus.
coagent8.claude.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Claude Code when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.claude.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.gemini.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model for Antigravity when a request names none. Empty uses `backends.gemini.defaultModel` from config.json, then the CLI default.

coagent8.approval.askAbovePrice.markdownDescription: Ask for your approval before a model whose output price is at least this many USD per million tokens. Overrides `governance.askAbovePrice` in config.json only when set here; to disable this threshold, set it to `null` in config.json.

coagent8.approval.priceMultiplier.markdownDescription: Ask for your approval before a model that costs at least this many times the backend's default model. Overrides `governance.priceMultiplier` in config.json only when set here.

coagent8.approval.alwaysAskModels.markdownDescription: Models that always need your approval before they run, even when listed in **Never Ask Models**. Added to `governance.alwaysAsk` in config.json.

coagent8.approval.neverAskModels.markdownDescription: Models that run without asking, unless listed in **Always Ask Models**. Added to `governance.neverAsk` in config.json, where an approval with "remember" is also saved.

coagent8.configPath.markdownDescription: Configuration file. Use an absolute path or ~/; empty uses coagent8_CONFIG, then a config.json in the extension's storage, which VS Code removes on uninstall. Set `~/.coagent8/config.json` to share the file with the `coagent8` CLI. CoAgent8 settings changed in VS Code take precedence. Open it with [CoAgent8: Open Configuration (config.json)](command:coagent8.openConfiguration).

coagent8.nodePath.markdownDescription: Node.js 24+ executable used to run the bundled MCP server. Set an absolute executable path if Node.js is not on PATH.
